title: A note on the Erdős distinct subset sums problem
notes: docs/problems/erdos_distinct_subset_sums.md. SIAM J. Discrete Math. 35 (2021) 322–324. Best published lower bound N ≥ (√(2/π) − o(1)) 2^n / √n and the exact N ≥ C(n, floor(n/2)). The isoperimetric proof uses ε ∈ {-1,0,+1}^n. This is the signed-alphabet baseline, not a BT novelty.
